ops.title: once-guard deletion gate relaxed to cache-decay-only
ops.body:
Decision (2026-07-13): the once-guard DELETION MANIFEST in captain_hook/once.py no longer
requires the upstream per-source hook dedup fix (anthropics/claude-code#76297) to land before
the shim can be deleted. The gate is now legacy-cache decay alone, proven per machine by the
three-check procedure in the docstring (installed plugins attach-only at every scope, settings
hooks-free, stale mirroring cache dirs purged or aged out).

Gate check at decision time:
- #76297: OPEN, no hook-command dedup in the Claude Code changelog through 2.1.207.
- Cache decay on this machine (yasyf's laptop): PASSES post-purge — installed consumers all
  attach-only (cc-context 0.14.0, cc-present 0.8.1, getaway 1.0.0, show@skills 0.1.6), all 15
  cc-pool accounts symlink to the shared ~/.claude/plugins, and the stale mirroring cache dirs
  (cc-context <=0.11.0, getaway <=0.8.0, show <=0.1.5) were purged 2026-07-13.

Rationale: with no mirroring source resolvable anywhere, the upstream fix protects nothing the
shim doesn't; keeping the shim until decay is proven fleet-wide still covers scope-churn
resurrection. Deletion itself remains deferred until the proof procedure passes on every
machine that runs the fleet.
